hints.title: Core Idea
hints.text: Iterate through the string and compute the absolute difference between character codes of adjacent characters.

hints.title: Pairwise Traversal
hints.text: For each index i from 0 to n - 2, take the difference between character at index i and character at index i + 1.

hints.title: Summation
hints.text: Sum all absolute differences and return the result.

hints.title: Implementation

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Not applicable; single pass is already optimal.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Use ASCII character codes to compute absolute differences.
